_comment.about: The Next.js half of the control app: the control fleet board (dockers, heartbeats, settings sync and the staff fleet actions) for the rokctapp shell (RokctAI_frontend). It moved here from RokctAI_frontend#204, which had added the pages to the shell directly; pages live in an SDK's nextjs layer and are composed in, as the rpanel pages come from hosting_sdk. The sidebar entry (app/handson/layout.tsx controlItems) and the control dashboard tile (app/handson/control/page.tsx) stay in the shell: both files are shell-owned and carry no @rokct-sdk marker for them. The demo fixtures (app/lib/fleet/demo.ts, used when ROKCT_DEMO_DATA=1 on guided-tour builds), the guide and the tour fragment ship with the pages.
_comment.app/services/control/base.ts: host-owned in RokctAI_frontend (ControlBaseService over gateway-rpc); the fleet services extend it.
_comment.dependencies: date-fns and sonner are already in the shell's package.json; listed at the shell's own ranges.
